_note: 1st India's own reporters, read by packages/core/src/breaking/reporters.ts. THE HANDLES ARE THE DESK'S OWN LIST and are the source of truth. THE JOIN KEY IS THE LATIN TOKEN IN THE BREAKING FILE NAME (BTN_RJ_BREAKING_6001_30OCT_US_CONTROL_Rituraj_Meeting_BIG -> 'RITURAJ'), matched case-insensitively with spaces, hyphens and underscores collapsed and a trailing SIR/JI dropped. Matching is EXACT on the whole token: a name the list does not carry tags nobody, it is never guessed at or fuzzy-matched.
_evidence: names_en were checked against the 6,878 breaking files this desk filed between 30 Oct and 10 Nov 2026; each entry's note says how many of those carried its token. Entries whose token never appears are kept anyway — they cost nothing and are ready the day the desk types that name.
_how_the_list_grows: An unmatched token is logged with the draft (handlePick.warnings) and shown on the desk. When an editor adds a reporter's handle to a draft by hand, the API records that story's file-name token against the handle in handle_directory (source 'reporter'), and the worker merges those learned tokens on its next reload — so the list completes itself from use. The highest-volume names still without a handle are RAJEEV, PK AGRAWAL / PK AGARWAL, SATYA, DINESH KASANA, SANJAY, LAXMAN, ASHOK, LAXMIKANT, CHANDRASHEKHAR and HANSHPAL.
